job.organization: Santa Clarita Community College District (CA) / College of the Canyons (CA)

items.item_text: 01. Do you possess a Bachelor’s degree or higher from an accredited college or university? If yes, please provide a legible copy of your college/university transcript in your application packet, with the degree(s) clearly visible. Copies of diplomas are not acceptable in lieu of college transcripts. If no, you do not meet the minimum qualifications for this position.

02. Describe your senior management level experience managing a performing arts center, theater, cultural venue, or similar organization. Include your responsibilities related to marketing, programming, operations, staffing, scheduling, and facility management. Include employer name(s), position title(s), dates of employment, full-time or part-time status (hours per week), your roles, and responsibilities. Please provide your total years of full-time equivalent experience in this field.
03. Describe your experience administering or working with budgets, grants, or external funding sources.
04. Describe your background working with educational programs, community, or government agencies related to the performing arts.
05. Describe what types of performing arts spaces you have previously working in and what role you played.
06. Describe your experience working with contracts to include but not limited to rental agreements, Riders, and service agreements.

07. Why do you want to work in this management position at College of the Canyons? What unique skills and aptitudes would you contribute to the Santa Clarita Performing Arts Center at College of the Canyons.
